title: Computer lab with projected presentation and multiple workstations
objects_and_counts: At least 13 people are visible in the photographed scene: three standing together at the front left near the projector screen, and at least ten seated at various workstations across the room. Some seated people are partially obscured by monitors.
At least 12 individual desktop monitors are visible across the room; several workstations show dual-monitor arrangements where both screens are visible on adjacent desks.
One ceiling-mounted projector is visible near the image top center, projecting onto one large front wall screen.
One large projection screen (pulled down) is visible on the front wall and is displaying a slide.

Multiple wheeled task chairs are visible: at least six red chairs, one orange chair (foreground left-center), and one blue chair (foreground right); additional chairs are present but some are partially obscured.
Multiple white rectangular tables are visible arranged in clusters; at least five table assemblies are visible in the foreground and midground.
A small tabletop sign holder is visible on a desk near the center foreground with a printed insert.
A wall-mounted sign with a no-smoking symbol is visible on the right-side wall.
Several personal items (backpacks, jackets draped over chairs) are visible near workstations but are treated as transient clutter.
visible_text: Delivering Effective Presentation with Slide deck and Video
spatial_relations: The ceiling-mounted projector is centered near the top of the image and projects onto a large screen on the front wall, which occupies the central-left portion of the front wall.
Three people are standing together near the front-left of the room, directly in front of the projection screen and slightly left of center in the image.
Rows of workstations run from the foreground toward the back of the room; clusters of tables form islands with monitors facing into the room so seated users have their backs or sides to the camera.
A cluster of monitors and chairs occupies the center foreground; another bank of monitors lines the right side of the room along the right wall.
The no-smoking sign is mounted on the right-side wall above a row of workstations and to the right of the projection screen area.
colours_and_materials: Walls have vertical panels in pale teal, white and dark blue colours.
Office chairs are predominantly red, with at least one orange chair in the foreground and one blue chair at the right foreground.
Workstation desks are white with light-coloured metal legs.
The floor is covered in a light grey carpet.
The projection screen displays a turquoise-blue slide background with white graphic elements.
